description: Detects the technologies a website uses: CMS, ecommerce platform, JS framework, web server, CDN/hosting, analytics, ad pixels, chat, payments, consent tools. Free preview by default (technology names and categories). With STACKDETECT_X402_PRIVATE_KEY set, returns the full paid result (versions, confidence, evidence, email / DNS / hosting providers, verified SaaS) from https://api.youraitools.co/stackdetect/v1/detect, paying $0.003 USDC on Base per lookup over x402. Informational: technologies inferred from public signals of one page load and public DNS. Detection can miss tools loaded later by JavaScript or hidden by the site; confidence is a heuristic.

url.description: URL or domain, e.g. https://laravel.com or shopify.com

name: detect_stack
title: What is this website built with?
